_readme: 基本能力與選配目錄；group 分 core/frontend/typescript/research/maintenance。default_enabled=true 才在一般 align 自動補裝缺項；false 只在明確 --only 時補裝。不重設本機開關。只收實際工具、資料或明確專案用途，通用方法論不常駐。第三方 version 未列者不保證版本可重現。

items.name: kb-retriever
items.note: local knowledge-base retrieval with PDF/Excel handling; used by knowledge-vault

items.name: web-design-guidelines
items.note: Vercel official; fetches latest Web Interface Guidelines at review time. Replaces the static web-interface-guidelines command (removed 2026-09-14).

items.name: frontend-design
items.note: CLI counterpart of the desktop built-in anthropic-skills:frontend-design; UI flow = frontend-design produces -> ui-ux-pro-max styles -> web-design-guidelines reviews

items.name: ui-ux-pro-max
items.note: bundles searchable CSV data (palettes/fonts/UX rules) and its own ui-styling skill; do not install a standalone ui-styling

items.name: gsap-skills
items.note: official set of 8 skills (core/timeline/scrolltrigger/plugins/react/frameworks/performance/utils); animation library choice is governed by 80-engineering

items.name: typescript-lsp
items.note: real type/reference queries for TS projects

items.name: context7
items.note: up-to-date library docs lookup (MCP); covers APIs newer than the model cutoff

items.name: hookify
items.note: turn hard constraints (50-safety red lines) into enforced hooks instead of prose

items.name: claude-md-management
items.note: audit CLAUDE.md quality and capture session learnings; supports 40-maintenance

items.name: kb-retriever
items.note: same content as the claude entry

items.name: web-design-guidelines
items.note: same content as the claude entry
